title: A Space on a hand-set paid plan can start its own subscription (LIVE-1224)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: subscribe The Group to Network so it can bill client websites (ADR-1816).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. A Space whose paid plan was set by hand (spaces.plan paid, no stripe_subscription_id, no manual agreement) used to show its own rung as 'current' with no way to buy, so it could never get the subscription that client-site billing (and the plan webhooks) attach to. The billing page now gives that one rung a Choose button; a Space with a subscription, a manual agreement or a staff viewer is unchanged, and no other rung is offered. The Group (plan network, owned by @frequency, no subscription) is the first case.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/plan-ladder.tsx','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/billing-body.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!l.includes('unbilledPlan === rung.plan'))bad.push('ladder no longer lets an unbilled plan start billing');if(!b.includes('stripe_subscription_id')||!b.includes('unbilledPlan'))bad.push('billing page does not detect an unbilled plan');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1224: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a hand-set paid plan can no longer start its own subscription.
